name: scale_vvel_1.5
hypothesis: Increase vertical velocity scaling to make the policy perceive faster descent, prompting more main engine usage to compensate for weaker thrust

name: scale_vvel_0.75
hypothesis: Reduce vertical velocity scaling to make the policy perceive slower descent, encouraging less main engine usage and thus reducing fuel consumption and steps, improving return under weaker main engine

name: scale_vvel_0.65
hypothesis: Further reduce vertical velocity scaling to 0.65 to decrease perceived descent speed, encouraging even less main engine usage and higher return, at risk of more crashes

name: scale_vvel_0.8
hypothesis: Slightly increase vertical velocity scaling to 0.8 (less reduction) to balance main engine usage, aiming for higher return while reducing crashes compared to 0.75 scaling

name: offset_main_minus0.2
hypothesis: Reduce main engine logit by -0.2 to discourage main engine usage, saving fuel and increasing return while maintaining safe landing

name: scale_vvel_0.85
hypothesis: Slightly increase vertical velocity scaling to 0.85 (less reduction) to see if a slightly higher perceived descent speed yields better return while still compensating for weaker main engine

name: scale_vvel_0.78
hypothesis: Slightly lower vertical velocity scaling (0.78) to further reduce perceived descent speed, encouraging even less main engine usage and potentially higher return while maintaining safe landings

name: scale_horiz_1.2_vert_0.78
hypothesis: Increase horizontal velocity scaling to 1.2 and set vertical velocity scaling to 0.78, making the policy more sensitive to lateral drift while perceiving slower descent, encouraging earlier side engine usage and less main engine usage, aiming for higher return under weak main engine

name: scale_horiz_1.5_vert_0.78
hypothesis: Increase horizontal velocity scaling to 1.5 while keeping vertical velocity scaling at 0.78 to make the policy more sensitive to lateral drift, encouraging earlier side‑engine corrections and smoother descent, which should improve return under the weaker main engine

name: scale_vert_0.78_side_plus0.2
hypothesis: Scale vertical velocity by 0.78 and add +0.2 bias to side engine logits to encourage side thrust for attitude control, reducing reliance on weaker main engine and improving return

name: scale_horiz_1.1_vert_0.78
hypothesis: Slightly reduce horizontal velocity scaling to 1.1 (from 1.2) while keeping vertical scaling at 0.78 to lessen over‑correction by side engines and improve overall return under weak main engine

name: scale_horiz_1.25_vert_0.78
hypothesis: Slightly increase horizontal velocity scaling to 1.25 while keeping vertical scaling at 0.78 to improve side‑engine responsiveness without over‑correction, aiming for higher return under weak main engine
